prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Hollow Seraph, a steampunk angel of doom hovering in the air, built of separate pieces that float apart: a hollow shell of blackened steel and polished brass armour plates (a helm-mask, a chest cuirass in two halves, two shoulder plates, two gauntlets and a long segmented skirt of plates), each plate a solid riveted shape hovering a little apart from the others with narrow empty gaps between them and nothing inside; in the gap at the centre of the chest a brass clockwork heart of interlocking gears glows white-gold; the faceless brass helm-mask has one narrow horizontal slit glowing cold white; a broken brass halo ring with gear teeth floats close above the helm; exactly four great wings in all, two on each side and no more: on the left side of the image one upper wing pointing up and out and one lower wing pointing down and out, and the same two on the right side of the image, with empty space between the upper and the lower wing (no wing pointing straight out to the side); each wing one straight blade of pale gold-white light held in a brass frame, like a sword blade, each wing's brass frame joined to a shoulder plate; the wings are short, each blade no longer than the helm-to-skirt height of the armour: the upper wing tips reach no higher than the top of the halo and the lower wing tips no lower than the bottom of the skirt, all four tips well inside the grey box on the left and the right; the whole figure, halo and wing tips included, fills only the lower nine tenths of the grey box with clear empty space above the halo; the gaps between the plates are narrow and the whole figure stays compact; nothing below the skirt (no feet, no wind, no shadow); palette of blackened steel, brass, gold, a cold white glow and pale gold light. FACE: no face; the faceless brass helm-mask with its glowing slit and the gear heart are the readable features.

Pose: idle, a ready battle stance, facing right.

BODY: hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a face, skin, a body or bones inside the armour, feathers, feathered wings, more or fewer than four wings, six wings, three wings on a side, a horizontal middle wing, a sword in the hands, white-and-gold armour, a cape, violet, purple, pink, magenta.
